description: Defines the QuicConnectionId class and related constants and enums for managing QUIC connection IDs, including creation, comparison, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: QuicConnectionId
classes.description: Represents a QUIC connection ID with methods for creation, comparison, and string conversion.

classes.name: QuicConnectionIdHash
classes.description: Hash functor for QuicConnectionId objects for use in hash tables.

methods.name: QuicConnectionId
methods.description: Default constructor for an empty connection ID.

methods.name: QuicConnectionId
methods.description: Constructor that initializes from raw bytes or span.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the connection ID.

methods.name: set_length
methods.description: Sets the length of the connection ID.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the connection ID bytes.

methods.name: mutable_data
methods.description: Returns a mutable pointer to the connection ID bytes.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the connection ID is empty.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Computes a hash value for the connection ID.

methods.name: ToString

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs the connection ID to a stream.
